1: T’bul Yom I, 1 נושכות זו בזו
T’bul Yom I, 1 ק׳ של מים המחולחלת (not שלמים) a hollow ball of water, bubble, froth
T’bul Yom I, 1 רְתִיחַת … ראשונה the first scum that comes up in boiling groats of beans
ib. 2 ק׳ של מים שאינה מחולחלת a solid water globule, drop—2) marrow-bone, esp. thigh-bone
Ib. 2 ר׳ יין ישן the scum of old wine.
T’bul Yom I, 3 מ׳ שאחר הככר the knob on the back of the loaf (supposed to serve as trade-mark)
T’bul Yom I, 4 הצ׳ שבככר a pebble (or a piece of earthen ware) put as a mark on a loaf
T’bul Yom I, 5 (Var. in Ar. אילום, הלום)
T’bul Yom I, 5 התיאה (ed. Dehr. התייה; Maim.: ‘some say, tiah is the root of asafœtida’)
2: T’bul Yom II, 3 אם היה מפ׳ וכ׳ if the garlic was scattered in the mortar
T’bul Yom II, 3 מפני שהוא רוצה בפִיזּוּרוֹ because the scattering (of the garlic in the mortar) is welcome to him
T’bul Yom II, 4 אם חי׳ if the unclean person stirred (the jelly with the oil on top)
T’bul Yom II, 5 בשר הקדש שקרם עליו הקי׳ (ed. Dehr. הקו׳; Ar. שקרש … הקו׳)
T’bul Yom II, 8 ב׳ שבחבית (an imperfection in an earthen jug) a protuberance
3: T’bul Yom III, 1 אוכל שנפרס ומע׳ מקצת if an eatable part of a fruit is broken off but partly hangs on (is not entirely severed)
T’bul Yom III, 1, v. עָרָה II
T’bul Yom III, 6 תמרים י׳, opp. רטובות
T’bul Yom III, 6 שנגס מן האוכל וכ׳ (not שנגוס) who took a bite of some food, and something mixed with his saliva fell on his garments.
T’bul Yom III, 6 תמרים רטובות (Ar. ed. pr. רוֹטְבוֹת)
4: T’bul Yom IV, 2 בכ׳ מצרית או וכ׳ on an inverted basket of twigs or on a tray (which have no distinct receptacles, בית קבול)
T’bul Yom IV, 4 ל׳ … ומלאהו וכ׳ a lagin which requires sunset to be clean (v. טָבַל) and which was filled out of a cask containing tithes …
T’bul Yom IV, 6 ואנ׳ שלהם קיימת and the hook (attached to the now broken yoke) remained unimpaired
T’bul Yom IV, 6 מ׳ של ראש hair-comb
T’bul Yom IV, 6. [Ar. reads מעדר, with Var. lect. מעבר, מעפר.]
T’bul Yom IV, 7 שלום מן הש׳ וכ׳ (he meant) that it will be brought up in safety without being broken and without being spilt
T’bul Yom IV, 7, a. e. שתעלה ש׳ that it will be brought up safely, v. שֶׁבֶר I
T’bul Yom IV, 7, v. שֶׁבֶר I
